predictions.claim: Oracle coordinates (true planted units' value-path images on the semi model, no CP) certify >= 20/24 at R2 >= 0.8 under the frozen gate — the gate is exonerated and D3's failure attributes upstream.
Symmetric scoring (semi projected onto the 24-dim unit span, or pulled through an identically-fit ridge map) erases the D2 reversal: semi lands within 5 points of learned or above it.

Across 4 train seeds of identifiable/semi, the D1 fraction at cosine >= 0.9 spans the 0.8 bar (at least one seed passes and at least one fails) — the single-seed FAIL becomes 'below-bar on average, not seed-stable'.
With per-token standard errors, the identifiable top-2 selection-vs-PCA privilege ratio 1.27 is within 2 SE of 1.0 — no resolvable privilege, D4 restated as 'directionally consistent, underpowered'.

decision_rule: F1+F2 hold -> §38 is amended: D2 reversal retracted as artifact, D3 reframed as composition failure (downgrade unchanged, phase-2 targets shift upstream). F3 either way replaces the 'third of the units' prose with a seed distribution. F4 either way replaces 'supported' with an interval statement.
